'''''After''''' is the title of two different chapters in ''[[The Wheel of Time]]'' series, final chapters in their books:

* The [[The Great Hunt/Chapter 50|fiftieth chapter]] of ''[[The Great Hunt]]''.
* The [[The Path of Daggers/Chapter 31|thirty-first chapter]] of ''[[The Path of Daggers]]''.
